item.title: UM Grace Pilot School of Business Dean Kathy Dunning to retire; national search underway
item.description: The University of Mobile announced that Kathy Dunning, dean of the Grace Pilot School of Business, will retire at the conclusion of the 2025–2026 academic year. University officials have launched a national search for her successor.

item.title: Return of the neighborhood church? Rainer encourages ‘welcome and relationship.’
item.description: Evangelism is “the headwaters of everything,” according to pastor and ministry leader Sam Rainer. “All church health flows downstream from evangelism.”

item.title: Regular attenders aren’t joining your church? This may be why.
item.description: Maybe you know these people. They’ve been attending your church for some time — certainly long enough now to have decided whether to join officially.

item.title: When a small church believes God can do big things
item.description: Eight women from Union Chapel Missionary Baptist Church in Kingston, Tennessee, felt God stirring their hearts to make hundreds of fried pies to support International Mission Board missionaries.

item.title: First Person: Walking the road to resurrection
item.description: There is something profoundly moving about the final days of Jesus — each day is filled with purpose, love and glory. The Passion Week is the most holy of all weeks for the Church.

item.title: Longtime pastor Douglas Haynes dies at 82
item.description: Douglas Haynes, a longtime bivocational pastor in Randolph and Cleburne counties, died Feb. 2. The churches he served included Chulafinnee Baptist and Pine Grove Baptist, both in Heflin, and Ethelsville Baptist.

item.title: First person: New missionaries share what surprised them the most
item.description: Sometimes it takes two hours just to get groceries. A doctor’s visit will most likely require Google Translate at some point. Air pollution skyrockets during winter months. Language learning is not for the faint of heart.
